Dr. Molo | Veterinarian—Animal Health & Pet Educator

I'm new to YouTube but not new to veterinary medicine! Join Rouge and me as we grow this channel together, bringing you insights from years in clinical practice, vet pharma, and pet nutrition.

Texas-licensed veterinarian with specialized background in animal nutrition, veterinary pharmaceuticals, and the feed industry. DVM with experience across small animal, equine, and mixed practice—from the clinic to the manufacturing floor, giving you the vet perspective you won't find elsewhere. 

Weekly tips on pet health and nutrition, breed breakdowns, and honest takes on food, treats, and tech. Plus commentary on fun and relevant animal news topics!

I'll reveal where the name "Dr. Molo" comes from when we hit 1,000 subscribers! 🎉

📧 drmolo4pets@gmail.com
🔔 Subscribe for honest, science-based pet care advice.
